```plato
    // The principal moments a diagonal tensor was built from. Reading only the
    // diagonal is exact when the tensor IS diagonal — which is the case for every
    // shape in this section — and is the principal-frame approximation otherwise.
    PrincipalMoments(tensor: SymmetricMatrix3x3): Vector3D
        => Vector3D(tensor.M11, tensor.M22, tensor.M33);
```

```plato
    // The principal moments of a solid ball: 2/5 m r^2 about every axis through
    // the centre — a ball has no distinguished axis, so its tensor is a multiple
    // of the identity and stays diagonal under any rotation.
    PrincipalMoments(s: Sphere, mass: Mass): Vector3D
    {
        var i = 0.4 * mass.Amount * s.Radius.Square;
        return Vector3D(i, i, i);
    }
```

## Line 237

**Source:** [stdlib/future/rigid-dynamics.library.plato, line 237](../../../../../stdlib/future/rigid-dynamics.library.plato#L237).

```plato

    // The principal moments of a solid box about its own axes: m (b^2 + c^2) / 12
    // per axis, over the two FULL extents perpendicular to it.
    PrincipalMoments(b: Box3D, mass: Mass): Vector3D
    {
        var k = mass.Amount / 12.0;
        var w = b.Size.Width.Square;
        var h = b.Size.Height.Square;
        var d = b.Size.Depth.Square;
        return Vector3D(k * (h + d), k * (w + d), k * (w + h));
    }
```

```plato
    // The principal moments of a solid right circular cylinder, in a frame whose
    // LOCAL Z runs along the cylinder's axis: m r^2 / 2 about the axis and
    // m (3 r^2 + h^2) / 12 across it, over the FULL height.
    PrincipalMoments(c: Cylinder, mass: Mass): Vector3D
    {
        var m = mass.Amount;
        var across = m * (3.0 * c.Radius.Square + c.Height.Square) / 12.0;
        return Vector3D(across, across, 0.5 * m * c.Radius.Square);
    }
```

## Line 258

**Source:** [stdlib/future/rigid-dynamics.library.plato, line 258](../../../../../stdlib/future/rigid-dynamics.library.plato#L258).

```plato

    // The principal moments of a solid capsule, in a frame whose LOCAL Z runs from
    // A to B: a cylinder of the spine's length capped by two hemispheres, each
    // contributing its own inertia plus a parallel-axis shift to the capsule's
    // centre. The two masses are split by volume, so the result depends on the
    // radius and the spine length only through the ratio of the two parts.
    PrincipalMoments(c: Capsule3D, mass: Mass): Vector3D
    {
        var r = c.Radius;
        var h = c.A.Distance(c.B);
        var cylinderVolume = Number.Pi * r.Square * h;
        var capVolume = 2.0 / 3.0 * Number.Pi * r.Square * r;
        var total = cylinderVolume + 2.0 * capVolume;
        var mc = total > 0.0 ? mass.Amount * cylinderVolume / total : 0.0;
        var mh = total > 0.0 ? mass.Amount * capVolume / total : 0.0;
        var along = 0.5 * mc * r.Square + 2.0 * mh * 0.4 * r.Square;
        var across = mc * (h.Square / 12.0 + r.Square * 0.25)
            + 2.0 * mh * (0.4 * r.Square + h.Square * 0.25 + 0.375 * h * r);
        return Vector3D(across, across, along);
    }
```
